title: Deliver the KiCad Parts Platform
description: Build the Rust/Tauri/Leptos KiCad Parts Platform defined in docs/PRODUCT_PLAN.md. Existing CSV catalogs and local CAD libraries are read-only import fixtures, PocketBase is the selected team backend, and Linux is the primary isolated AFK integration environment. Completion requires the roadmap exit criteria, deterministic backup and restore evidence, later native Windows and macOS release validation, and no unsafe mutation of active KiCad projects or libraries.

title: Receive and estimate one physical reel end to end
description: Outcome: Deliver the first runnable Inventory vertical slice. From empty inventory, an authorized user receives one real reel into a named local site, previews or prints its internal carrier label, records supplier-declared quantity, adds an exact or estimated Quantity Observation, and confirms any Adjustment Stock Movement. The compact Inventory row and part side sheet show confidence and evidence. | Scope and invariants: Add the minimum Rust domain/application contracts, SQLite/PocketBase records, protected commands, Leptos/Rust-UI views, and deterministic fixtures for Recorded Owner, Custodian, Inventory Site, Storage Location, Stock Holding, Receipt Lot, physical Stock Container, Stock Movement, Quantity Observation, Quantity Confidence, and Stock State. Keep supplier/source, Recorded Owner, Custodian, and site independent even when local defaults make the normal receipt short. Enforce whole-piece nonnegative quantities and 0 <= lower_bound <= expected_quantity <= upper_bound. Receive/adjust retries are idempotent; movements are immutable; direct quantity-cell editing is not canonical. This slice excludes partner balances, Reservations, Stock Floors, and procurement allocation. | AFK verification: Rust unit and property tests cover movement arithmetic, declared versus observed quantity, bounds, split-safe identity, retry, optimistic concurrency, authorization, and invalid input. A real pinned PocketBase contract test applies migrations/rules, receives and adjusts the reel, restarts, and proves the same projection and audit history. WebdriverIO browser and native Linux Tauri journeys cover empty, receive, label preview, populated row, part sheet, estimate/reconcile, validation error, duplicate retry, permission denial, conflict, offline, and success. Retain semantic, keyboard/focus, axe-compatible accessibility, deterministic 1280x800 screenshots/diffs, logs, manifest, and agent visual-review note through the cargo xtask AFK entry point. | Acceptance: The reel is drillable from part summary to site, carrier, Receipt Lot, observation, and immutable movements without false precision. Replaying a command changes quantity once; failed/concurrent commands preserve prior state. Expected and conservative quantities are visibly distinct, unusable stock is never called available, and common receiving fits one focused flow without horizontal page scrolling or an unbounded form.

title: See one part across local and partner-held stock
description: Outcome: Show one Managed Part distributed between a labeled local Stock Container and a partner-reported aggregate balance. An authorized user can add or import the balance, see a compact local/partner distribution summary, and open a site/custodian side sheet that labels it as aggregate, dated, restricted, and evidence-backed rather than as a fictional reel. | Scope and invariants: Extend the first tracer with partner Inventory Sites/accounts, Partner Stock Balances, Use Constraints, source/as_of/confidence evidence, and the Inventory Position read model. The same organization may be supplier/source, Custodian, assembler, or another party role, but those facts remain independent. A partner balance never claims carrier ID, Receipt Lot, manufacturer lot, date code, or exact count without source evidence. Owned, local, partner-held, reserved/protected, quarantined, and in-transit facts stay separate. No universal available total is introduced; allocatable appears only with explicit demand policy. Import/manual reconciliation uses stable partner/account/part and correlation keys and preserves previous observations. | AFK verification: Rust unit/property tests cover holding compatibility, party-role independence, aggregate evidence, freshness/confidence, no fabricated traceability, idempotent/out-of-order observations, and deterministic projections. A real pinned PocketBase adapter test imports, retries, updates, and restarts while preserving source history and authorization. WebdriverIO browser/native Linux Tauri journeys cover local-only, distributed, stale, uncertain, restricted, malformed import, permission, conflict, offline, and sync-error states. Screenshots cover overview, filters, distribution cell, collapsed/expanded side sheet, Aggregate partner balance label, evidence drill-down, stale warning, and 1280x800 bounded scrolling; axe/keyboard/focus and agent visual critique are required. | Acceptance: The row summarizes local and partner-held quantities without calling the sum available; the side sheet groups by Inventory Site/Custodian. Local carrier detail remains visible while external carrier/lot fields are absent or explicitly unknown. Stale/restricted balances cannot satisfy disallowed demand. Duplicate or out-of-order imports cannot inflate quantity or erase evidence.

title: Protect local prototype coverage while reserving one build
description: Outcome: Let an authorized user protect practical local prototype coverage and reserve one production build without changing physical on-hand. The user sets Keep local as pieces or enough for N builds of an exact saved Project Revision/variant, previews per-part Stock Floors, activates them, creates a Material Reservation, and reviews allocation exceptions. | Scope and invariants: Add Material Reservations, Stock Allocations, Stock Floors, demand-specific Allocatable Quantity, exact Project Revision/variant references, attrition inputs, override reasons, and floor-deficit replenishment signals. Reservations are time-bounded named claims; floors are standing site policies. Neither creates a Stock Movement or selects a physical carrier until allocation. Newer Project Revisions may propose, never silently rewrite, active floors. Allocation uses conservative eligible quantity, excludes quarantine and incompatible owner/site/pool/traceability, subtracts other allocations, and protects non-consumable floors. An authorized emergency override records a reason and exposes replenishment deficit. | AFK verification: Rust unit/property tests cover reservation lifecycle, partial allocation/shortage, floor arithmetic, exact-revision derivation, exemptions, quarantine invalidation, concurrent allocators, override authorization, release/reallocation, and unchanged movement totals. A real pinned PocketBase test proves atomic commands, rules, retry, realtime reconciliation, restart, and competing writers. WebdriverIO browser/native Linux Tauri journeys cover direct Keep local, N-build preview/confirm, changed Project Revision review, compatible allocation, incompatible-pool exception, Local shortfall with Transfer before Purchase, emergency override, permission, conflict, offline, and sync failure. Require deterministic screenshots, semantic quantities, keyboard/focus, axe compatibility, and agent review through AFK orchestration. | Acceptance: With local 120, floor 100, and another allocation 10, unrelated demand can allocate at most 10. Reserve/release changes projections and audit history, never on-hand/custody. Preview shows revision, variant, builds, attrition, pieces, coverage, and exceptions. Quarantine is allowed and turns affected Reservations into visible shortages. Common flows use focused sheets and avoid per-carrier selection unless policy requires it.

title: Transfer and reconcile one restricted partner stock pool
description: Outcome: Prove safe use of one restricted partner stock pool by reconciling partner consumption and moving owned material between partner and local sites. The user sees why pools cannot mix, dispatches a whole or partial quantity into one in-transit position, confirms destination receipt, and reconciles the next report without double counting or invented detail. | Scope and invariants: Add effective partner use/transfer constraints, dispatch and receipt commands, In-Transit Stock, whole/partial transfer behavior, reconciliation exceptions, and source-versus-inventory authority transition. Public supplier stock and unreceived Procurement commitments are never Inventory; once supply becomes owned Inventory it stops counting as inbound. A holding has one current custody/site position. Dispatch removes endpoint allocatability; receipt establishes destination custody; retry conserves whole pieces. Partial physical transfers create separately traceable children when identity is known; aggregate balances reduce without invented lots. Build-only, non-transferable, customer-specific, non-mixable, stale, quarantined, or low-confidence pools fail with a specific reason. | AFK verification: Rust unit/property tests cover balanced transfer legs, retry, partial split provenance, owner/custodian transitions, pool non-mixing, stale/malformed/out-of-order observations, missing receipt, quarantine in transit, and Procurement/Inventory double-count prevention. A real pinned PocketBase partner-adapter test imports, dispatches, restarts mid-transfer, receives locally, reconciles use/new balance, retries every command, and proves evidence history/authorization. WebdriverIO browser/native Linux Tauri journeys cover restricted explanation, whole/partial move, in-transit row, receipt, stale balance, variance, retry/conflict, permission, revoked credential, offline, and sync error. Screenshots show before/during/after, non-mixable exception, partial child, stale evidence, and reconciliation at 1280x800 with semantic conservation, focus/keyboard, accessibility, and agent review. | Acceptance: Stock is counted once and cannot simultaneously appear as inbound, partner-held, in transit, and local. Incompatible/non-transferable pools cannot silently combine; UI names policy and next action. Reconciliation preserves source/as_of/confidence and prior evidence without invented carrier, lot, date code, or legal ownership. Whole moves use one confirmation; partial moves request quantity and preserve traceability. Received stock remains subject to state, constraints, Reservations, and Floors.
